registration.method: Reconstruct exact 191 binary64 normalized/clipped feature vectors. Count raw vs normalized within-row valid target rivals and full ordered-input conflicts; per-feature clipping and original OOD; structural upper bounds before/after unchanged OOD, not performance.
registration.inputKey: Big-endian uint32 candidate count, all191D binary64 option vectors in native order with signed zero collapsed, valid bytes, uint32 cleanup/before/outside indices, uint8 allowInference. Labels/IDs/folds excluded.

"""Read-only identifiability of the fixed scorer's actual clipped inputs; never import a fitter."""
from pathlib import Path
import collections,gzip,hashlib,json,struct
p=Path(__file__).resolve().parent;source=p.parent/'barrel-native-catalog-ranker-fit-20261118'
regraw=(p/'registration.json').read_bytes();reg=json.loads(regraw);sha=lambda b:hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()
for entry in reg['inputs']:assert sha((source/entry['path']).read_bytes())==entry['sha256']
model=json.loads((source/'validation-selected-model.json').read_text());width=len(model['mean']);assert width==191
mean=list(map(float,model['mean']));scale=list(map(float,model['scale']));constant=model['constant']
assert all(v>0 for v in scale)
def vector_key(values):return b''.join(struct.pack('>d',0. if v==0 else float(v)) for v in values)
def input_key(features,row):
 h=hashlib.sha256();h.update(struct.pack('>I',len(features)))
 for v in features:h.update(v)
 h.update(bytes(row['valid']))
 h.update(struct.pack('>III?',row['cleanupIndex'],row['beforeIndex'],row['outsideIndex'],row['allowInference']))
 return h.digest()
def group_summary(groups):
 return {'distinctOrderedInputs':len(groups),'contradictoryOrderedInputs':sum(len(v['targets'])>1 for v in groups.values()),'contradictoryGroupsWithDistinctRawInputs':sum(len(v['targets'])>1 and len(v['raw'])>1 for v in groups.values()),'maxObservedCorrect':sum(max(v['targets'].values()) for v in groups.values())}
def add(groups,key,raw,target):
 group=groups.setdefault(key,{'targets':collections.Counter(),'raw':set()});group['targets'][target]+=1;group['raw'].add(raw)
folds={};all_raw={};all_normal={}
for fold in ['train','validation']:
 counts=collections.Counter();raw_groups={};normal_groups={};clipped_per_feature=[0]*width;valid_clipped_per_feature=[0]*width
 with gzip.open(source/'data'/f'{fold}.jsonl.gz','rt') as f:
  for line in f:
   row=json.loads(line);assert row['fold']==fold;counts['records']+=1
   rawkeys=[];normalkeys=[];ood=False;rowclip=False
   for features,valid in zip(row['features'],row['valid']):
    assert len(features)==width
    values=[float(v) for v in features];normalized=[]
    for i,v in enumerate(values):
     z=(v-mean[i])/scale[i];clipped=abs(z)>8
     if clipped:clipped_per_feature[i]+=1;valid_clipped_per_feature[i]+=int(valid);counts['clippedCoordinates']+=1;rowclip=True
     if clipped or constant[i] and abs(v-mean[i])>1e-8:ood=True
     normalized.append(max(-8.,min(8.,z)))
    rawkeys.append(vector_key(values));normalkeys.append(vector_key(normalized));counts['options']+=1;counts['validOptions']+=int(valid)
   counts['rowsWithClipping']+=int(rowclip);counts['oodRows']+=int(ood)
   validraw=collections.Counter(k for k,v in zip(rawkeys,row['valid']) if v);validnormal=collections.Counter(k for k,v in zip(normalkeys,row['valid']) if v)
   target=row['targetIndex'];assert row['valid'][target]
   rawsize=validraw[rawkeys[target]];normsize=validnormal[normalkeys[target]]
   counts['rawTargetAliased']+=int(rawsize>1);counts['normalizedTargetAliased']+=int(normsize>1);counts['targetGainsRivalsAfterNormalization']+=int(normsize>rawsize)
   counts['admissibleTargetGainsRivalsAfterNormalization']+=int(normsize>rawsize and row['allowInference'] and not ood)
   buckets=collections.defaultdict(set)
   for a,b,valid in zip(rawkeys,normalkeys,row['valid']):
    if valid:buckets[b].add(a)
   counts['normalizedGroupsMergingDistinctValidRawVectors']+=sum(len(v)>1 for v in buckets.values())
   alternative=target not in [row['cleanupIndex'],row['outsideIndex']]
   counts['uniqueCompleteAlternativeTargetsBeforeOod']+=int(alternative and normsize==1 and row['allowInference'])
   counts['uniqueCompleteAlternativeTargetsAfterOod']+=int(alternative and normsize==1 and row['allowInference'] and not ood)
   raw=input_key(rawkeys,row);normal=input_key(normalkeys,row)
   add(raw_groups,raw,raw,target);add(normal_groups,normal,raw,target);add(all_raw,raw,raw,target);add(all_normal,normal,raw,target)
 folds[fold]={'counts':dict(sorted(counts.items())),'rawOrderedInputGroups':group_summary(raw_groups),'normalizedOrderedInputGroups':group_summary(normal_groups),'clippedCoordinatesByFeature':clipped_per_feature,'validClippedCoordinatesByFeature':valid_clipped_per_feature}
result={'passed':True,'registrationSha256':sha(regraw),'modelSha256':next(x['sha256'] for x in reg['inputs'] if x['path']=='validation-selected-model.json'),'scope':'Fixed train/validation normalization only. Equal transformed valid vectors share softmax mass; no weight change, fit, threshold selection, test parsing or strength data.','featureCount':width,'folds':folds,'combined':{'rawOrderedInputGroups':group_summary(all_raw),'normalizedOrderedInputGroups':group_summary(all_normal)},'testParsed':False,'rankerTuned':False,'freshStrengthFamilies':0,'servingPolicyChanged':False}
with (p/'result.json').open('x') as f:json.dump(result,f,indent=2,allow_nan=False);f.write('\n')
print(json.dumps({'passed':True,'registrationSha256':result['registrationSha256'],'folds':{k:v['counts'] for k,v in folds.items()},'combined':result['combined']}))

interpretation: Within-row normalized valid vector identity is the actual shared-scorer equality test. Clipping introduced no extra valid-vector aliases or ordered-input contradictions on these opened records.
